title: asteranthe asterias
intro: Asteranthe asterias, commonly known as African cigar plant, is a flowering plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Asteranthe asterias include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as being used to manage fever and relieve pain. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
